tei:div.tei:p: sngon brjod/ ༄༅/ /srid pa'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shing*// rnam grol bgrod pa'i lam gcig pu// lung rtogs gnyis bsdus zhi bsil chos// gus pa'i phyag gi yul du bsten// de yang gangs can bod kyi ljongs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba nas brtsams da lta'i bar du/ mkhas btsun bzang grub kyi skyes bu khyad par can bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa rnams kyis rang rang gi nyams myong gi steng nas byung ba'i man ngag sna tshogs pa zhig ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs rim byung rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs te bstan bcos dang zhal gdams/ zin bris dang cho ga lo rgyus dang rnam thar sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig rtsom 'bri gnang ste bzhugs pa de dag bar lam dus kyi 'gyur ba la brten nas mang po zhig chud zos su phyin pa ni bod phyi nang tsam ma yin par 'dzam gling gi skye 'gro yongs la gyong gun chen po zhig byung ste/ shin tu phangs pa'i gnas su gyur par ma zad/ da lta 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi skal par bzhugs pa dag las kyang*/ kha shas dpe rgyun dkon pas mi mngon pa'i dbyings su phebs la nye ba rnams mi nyams par dpe rgyun spel ba'i ched dang*/ yang phyag dpe shin tu mkho gal che ba khag thos bsam dang nyams len gnang mkhan/ dpal 'byor gyi rgyab rten de tsam med par spraus med du bzhugs rgyur thugs mnyes pa rnams kyis stabs bde'i thog nas phyag dpe khag thob pa'i ched/ wa ṇā badz+ra bid+yā dpe mdzod khang gis spar bskrun zhus dang zhu 'char bzhin/ da lam slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rang 'grel 'di nyid/ rang dgon gyi sprul sku dam chos nas par bskrun gyi sbyin bdag gnang ba la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ gzhan yang deb 'di'i zhu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba dge slong tshe ring shar pa/ mdun shog mdzes ris pa blo gros rab rgyas/ thon gsar rig mdzod du bcug mkhan blo bzang rdo rje rab gling*/

zhu dag gnang mkhan bstan 'dzin shes rab bcas phya ra gru 'degs gnang mkhan thams cad la thugs rje che zhes zhu ba ma zad/ ma 'ongs par phyag dpe gzigs mkhan rnams kyis dpe cha 'di'i steng nas bslab sbyang*/ zhib 'jug nyams len gang gzab kyis rang don du thos bsam sgom gsum/ gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ gnyis don du mkhas btsun bzang gsum ste/ dam pa'i ngang tshul dgu yis don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa zhig yong ba'i smon 'dun dang*/ de lta bu gnang rogs zhes kyang zhu ba lags/ de bzhin ma phyi gsal po ma thob pa dang*/ zhu dag gnad smin ma song ba sogs kyis lhag chad dang*/ nor 'khrul byung ba thams cad mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi drung du bshags shing*/ nor bcos bka' bslab kyang lhug por stsol gnang bka' drin zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/
